events.title: The 'Great Drowning of Men' storm surge hits the North Sea coast
events.description: A severe south-westerly gale drove the sea over the coasts of England, the Low Countries, Germany and Denmark. At least 25,000 people died, and the trading town of Rungholt vanished beneath the waves.
events.html: A severe south-westerly gale drove the sea over the coasts of England, the Low Countries, Germany and Denmark. At least 25,000 people died, and the trading town of Rungholt vanished beneath the waves.

events.title: Ivan IV crowned the first Tsar of All Russia
events.description: Aged 16, Ivan IV was crowned in the Kremlin's Dormition Cathedral with the title of tsar. His reign brought the conquest of Kazan and Astrakhan as well as the terror of the oprichnina.
events.html: Aged 16, Ivan IV was crowned in the Kremlin's Dormition Cathedral with the title of tsar. His reign brought the conquest of Kazan and Astrakhan as well as the terror of the oprichnina.

events.title: Rodney defeats the Spanish in the 'Moonlight Battle'
events.description: Admiral George Rodney's larger British fleet overwhelmed a Spanish squadron off Cape St Vincent in an unusual night action. The victory allowed him to resupply besieged Gibraltar.
events.html: Admiral George Rodney's larger British fleet overwhelmed a Spanish squadron off Cape St Vincent in an unusual night action. The victory allowed him to resupply besieged Gibraltar.

events.title: Ratification of the Eighteenth Amendment sets up Prohibition
events.description: Nebraska became the 36th state to ratify the amendment banning the manufacture and sale of alcohol, making it part of the US Constitution. Prohibition took effect a year later and lasted until 1933.

events.title: League of Nations Council holds its first meeting
events.description: The League's Council met for the first time in Paris, at the French Foreign Ministry. The League settled some minor disputes but failed to stop aggression in the 1930s.
events.html: The League's Council met for the first time in Paris, at the French Foreign Ministry. The League settled some minor disputes but failed to stop aggression in the 1930s.

events.title: Hitler moves into the Führerbunker in Berlin
events.description: Adolf Hitler took up residence in the air-raid shelter beneath the Reich Chancellery garden. He directed the final months of the war from there and killed himself in the bunker on 30 April.
events.html: Adolf Hitler took up residence in the air-raid shelter beneath the Reich Chancellery garden. He directed the final months of the war from there and killed himself in the bunker on 30 April.

events.title: Soyuz 4 and Soyuz 5 make the first crewed docking
events.description: Two Soviet spacecraft docked in orbit and two cosmonauts spacewalked from Soyuz 5 to Soyuz 4. It was the first exchange of crew between spacecraft, a rehearsal for building space stations.
events.html: Two Soviet spacecraft docked in orbit and two cosmonauts spacewalked from Soyuz 5 to Soyuz 4. It was the first exchange of crew between spacecraft, a rehearsal for building space stations.

events.title: Space Shuttle Columbia launches on its final mission
events.description: Columbia lifted off on mission STS-107 with seven astronauts. Foam debris struck its wing during launch, and the shuttle broke apart on re-entry sixteen days later, killing the crew.
